query: Prepare a one-page briefing for a meeting with Zepto on 17 November 2026. Cover what changed in the last 30 days (news, launches, hires, deals), cite a source URL for every fact, and end with three open questions to ask.
briefing:
# Pre-Meeting Briefing: Zepto
**Meeting date:** 17 November 2026
**Window reviewed:** 18 October to 17 November 2026

## Corporate and deals

- **Reported acquisition:** A report dated 15 Nov 2026 says a company has agreed to be acquired by Globex Corporation for $9.4 billion, citing people familiar with the matter, with closing expected next quarter. The snippet does not name Zepto, so confirm the target before relying on it. (https://wire-briefs.example/deals/acquisition-announced)
- **Funding (outside the window):** A company profile lists a $100M venture round on 1 July 2026 and a $450M Series H dated 16 Nov 2025. Both predate the 30-day window. (https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/YT08vmcifB58)

## Launches and marketing

- **Seoul Street campaign:** Zepto launched a fandom-led brand activation, with Anime India said to be next. Chief brand officer Chandan Mendiratta is quoted, and fans were to queue in Hyderabad on 14 November. (https://www.animationxpress.com/latest-news/zepto-lands-in-seoul-street-anime-india-is-up-next-the-fans-got-there-years-ago)

## Festive performance

- **Dhanteras:** Zepto delivered over 14,000 gold and silver coins in one hour, per the company's co-founder and CEO. (https://indiabusinesstrade.in/dhanteras-2026-zepto-delivers-over-14000-gold-and-silver-coins-in-one-hour.htm)
- **Diwali demand:** Festive hamper orders grew 3X versus last Diwali, and fashion purchases doubled, led by ethnic wear and accessories. Laddu was its most frequently ordered mithai. (https://www.ndtvprofit.com/business/from-gold-coins-to-diet-coke-what-diwali-shopping-carts-reveal-about-indias-consumption-12309693)

## Workforce and reputation

- **Holiday change:** Zepto moved its scheduled holiday from Tuesday to Monday after Diwali. CHRO Sneha Arora described it as a longer weekend for employees. (https://m.economictimes.com/news/company/corporate-trends/india-inc-lights-up-diwali-with-longer-weekends-flexible-work-and-extra-pay-for-festive-shifts/articleshow/135618893.cms)
- **Diwali bonus backlash:** A viral video reported a delivery partner received "cash-like coupons" instead of cash as a bonus. Online commenters criticised the company on pay and working conditions. (https://www.news18.com/viral/zeptos-diwali-bonus-video-goes-viral-delivery-partner-gets-cash-like-coupons-instead-of-money-peanuts-in-the-name-of-a-bonus-ws-l-10418467.html)

## Regulatory

- **Food licence suspensions:** Maharashtra's FDA suspended food licences for Blinkit, Zepto, and 103 others, with 105 licences in total. The actions were taken on 4 and 5 November. (https://www.rediff.com/news/commentary/2026/nov/06/fda-suspends-food-licence-of-blinkit-zepto-103-others/14358878a29915ea01709670aa484bc5)

## Hires

- No hiring or leadership-change reports were found in the provided results.

## Open questions

1. Can you confirm whether the Globex report refers to Zepto, and how an acquisition would affect our counterparty, contracts, and timeline?
2. How is Zepto addressing the Maharashtra food licence suspensions, and what compliance changes are in progress?
3. Following the Diwali bonus backlash, what changes are planned for delivery partner compensation, and is the 3X festive growth in hampers and fashion expected to continue?
